field_principles.fst_live_validated: True if FST pipeline ran end-to-end on ANY path (A, B, or C).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. complete: even if only PATH C succeeded.
field_principles.model_used: Which GGUF or transformers model was loaded (null if PATH C).
field_principles.n_test_prompts: Number of prompts run through FST pipeline.
field_principles.path_a_attempted: True if PATH A was tried.
field_principles.path_a_blocked_reason: Why PATH A failed or was skipped (model_not_cached, llama_cpp_missing, etc).
field_principles.path_b_attempted: True if PATH B was tried.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records GGUF cache check, llama_cpp check, transformers check, PATH C check.
